reasons.fun: I enjoyed making a safer cash policy, seeing its limit, removing it, and making a drain-first rogue push beyond the old wall. Long routine watches and some compact controls diluted that pleasure.
reasons.playAgainTomorrow: I would want to see what the deeper region requires and whether my current build keeps working.
reasons.recommend: I would recommend it to a friend who enjoys idle progression and programming an adventurer, with a warning that reports and priority rows demand reading.
reasons.checkInTomorrowUnprompted: The next unknown wall gives me a concrete reason to check the town again; this is stated intent, not observed spontaneous behavior in this scheduled agent cohort.
